[[File:Hayes Hunter 2020 Volunteer Award.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Hayes Hunter with his 2020 Volunteer Award.]]
'''Hayes Hunter''' (GEMP handle '''hayes''') is a member of [[Team 5]] and the 2023 World Champion. He finished 3rd at the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="fc-home">[http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ FreedomCon home page], decktech.net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011201221615/http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ Internet Archive, 1 December 2001]</ref> [[Eric Hunter]] is his brother.<ref name="worlds24-wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-worlds-wrap-up-joe-olson-earns-third-championship-win/ 2024 Worlds Wrap-Up - Joe Olson Earns Third Championship Win], starwarsccg.org: &ldquo;Hayes&rsquo; award was presented by his brother Eric Hunter&rdquo;. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016161839/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-worlds-wrap-up-joe-olson-earns-third-championship-win.html Internet Archive]</ref> He flew to the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] at 14 with his family.<ref name="pds2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJuistFFk9M&t=1813s SWCCG PDS2: Hayes Hunter Worlds 2023 Champion Interview], BillBisco2 (10 May 2025), 30:13–32:30. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-qJuistFFk9M Internet Archive]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016010406/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJuistFFk9M watch-page snapshot] (Wayback 16 October 2026).</ref> He played the [[2026 European Championship]].<ref name="pc-euro">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-10-european-championship-bochum-germany-sept-19-20-2026/ 2026-10 European Championship], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026184405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-10-european-championship-bochum-germany-sept-19-20-2026.html?copy=3 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Star Trek CCG ==

Hunter reached the Star Trek CCG Final Confrontation at the 2003 World Championships, held at DecipherCon with [[Gen Con 2003]] in Indianapolis. He lost the best-of-three final 0–2. On [[Radio Free Decipher]] Broadcast 171, [[Kyle Heuer]] and [[Evan Lorentz]], who called the final as commentator, said Hunter had not lost on Day Three until the final. They added that he had been the 2002 North American Continental Champion in The Lord of the Rings TCG.<ref name="rfd171">[http://www.decipher.com/rfd/archives/audio/rfd_03_08_01.ra Radio Free Decipher, Broadcast 171 (1 August 2003)], [[Kyle Heuer]] and [[Evan Lorentz]], Decipher, 4:24–4:42 and 6:51–8:43. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060629234418/http://www.decipher.com/rfd/archives/audio/rfd_03_08_01.ra Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rfd-list03">[http://www.decipher.com/rfd/archives/index2003.html RFD Archives 2003], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207022726/http://www.decipher.com/rfd/archives/index2003.html Internet Archive]</ref>
